tax.text: Reschenthaler championed the One Big Beautiful Bill to make the 2017 Trump tax cuts permanent.
tax.quote: Prevents a 22 percent tax hike on working families by making the 2017 Trump tax cuts permanent

debt.text: He says he is committed to protecting Social Security and Medicare and opposes privatizing them.
debt.quote: I do not support efforts to privatize Social Security or dismantle Medicare.

immigration.text: He calls for enhanced border security with a wall and ending sanctuary city policies.
immigration.quote: Congress needs to pass legislation to fix our broken immigration system, enhance border security with a wall, and end dangerous sanctuary city policies.

guns.text: He describes gun ownership as a fundamental freedom and opposes eroding the Second Amendment.
guns.quote: I am committed to protecting the rights of law-abiding citizens to purchase, possess, and use firearms.

abortion.text: He identifies as pro-life and says there is a shared responsibility to protect unborn children.
abortion.quote: We share a responsibility to protect the lives of unborn children.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: He backed the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act to bar transgender athletes from women's sports.
gender.quote: I am proud to support the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act and will continue fighting to ensure future generations of female athletes compete on a level playing field.

health.text: He favors free-market solutions and competition over government mandates for health coverage.
health.quote: free market solutions and competitive innovation, not government mandates, will provide coverage options

voting.text: He joined a statement objecting to Pennsylvania's 2020 mail-in ballot practices, refusing to back electors from what he called an inaccurate vote count.
voting.quote: Until these unlawful practices are acknowledged and corrected, we cannot agree to support electors chosen based upon an inaccurate total vote count.
